findings: 35/35 effect names confirmed in Helper; current Schedule1 Tools mixer package exports 34 effect codes.
114 transformation rules are documented by Schedule1 Tools.
Community /mixes page is client-rendered and currently exposes 0 results to the crawler, so missing community records must not be fabricated.
Individual schedule1.tools/mixer share pages are crawlable and are treated as the authority for a stored community mix's exact ingredients/effects/price.
Some live community mix results differ from results produced by the older open-source mixer snapshot; the Helper therefore stores live-page verification separately from derived calculations.
asset_policy: Never invent an exact icon. Use a named public asset only when its source identifies the effect/item; otherwise use the verified in-game color/name treatment.
